That bundle cannot stay in the ones column, so it marches next door to the tens 🚪. what does adrenaline actually do to my body

Two glands sitting on top of your kidneys release adrenaline straight into your blood. Within seconds your heart speeds up, your airways widen, your pupils dilate and stored sugar is pushed out as fuel. Blood is redirected to the big muscles and away from your skin and gut, which is the cold hands and churning stomach before a match.
